summary: The article accurately reports Signature Global's Q1 FY27 pre-sales figures and their year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter changes, as well as the impact of the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch.

claims.claim: Signature Global reported pre-sales of ₹1,970 crore for Q1 FY27
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm this figure for Q1 FY27 pre-sales.

claims.claim: This figure represents a robust 25% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) growth
claims.note: The 25% QoQ growth is consistently reported across various news outlets.

claims.claim: the pre-sales were 25% lower on a year-on-year (YoY) basis compared to Q1 FY26
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm a 25% YoY decline in pre-sales for Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26.

claims.claim: The launch of Tonino Lamborghini Residences was a significant contributor to the QoQ sales surge.
claims.note: News reports explicitly state that the Tonino Lamborghini Residences launch drove the QoQ sales increase.

claims.claim: Signature Global tied up with Italian lifestyle brand Tonino Lamborghini to develop a luxury housing project in Gurugram with an investment of nearly ₹2,900 crore. It will develop 812 homes in the 12.4 acre project.
claims.note: Details about the collaboration, investment, number of homes, and project area are consistent across sources.

article_title: Signature Global Q1 FY27 Pre-Sales: A Closer Look at Growth
